description:
YITAMOTOR Towing mirrors expand outward farther than the standard truck mirrors, expanding your aft vision to assist with giving a more secure towing experience. We offer extendable towing mirrors with power-heated upper glass and a turn signal light.
Fitment
2007 Chevy Silverado Pickup new body style models
2007 GMC Sierra Pickup new body style models
2007-2013 Chevy Tahoe / Suburban / Avalanche
2007-2013 GMC Yukon XL Denali
2008-2013 Chevy Silverado All Models
2008-2013 GMC Sierra All Models
2014 Chevy Silverado 2500HD 3500HD
2014 GMC Sierra 2500HD 3500HD
NOT fit 2014 Silverado Sierra New Body Style Models
NOT fit 2007 Silverado Sierra Classic Models
Professional installation would be highly recommended
Features
Fitment: compatible with Chevy Silverado GMC Sierra 2007 New Body Style, Chevy Silverado GMC Sierra 2008 - 2013 All Models, Chevy Tahoe 2007 - 2013 Suburban Avalanche, 2007-2013 GMC Yukon/Yukon XL/Yukon Denali, Chevy Silverado GMC Sierra 2014 2500HD 3500HD Truck
Package contents & dimensions: a pair of telescoping trailer tow mirrors, including driver side and passenger side; side mirror length is 18.5” (closed) and 21.26” (extended); side mirror size is 12”×8.89”
Functions: featuring power adjustable & power heated plane mirror, manually adjustable convex lens, LED turning signal light, clearance light, manual telescoping & manual folding, the multifunctional side mirrors can strikingly enhance your driving experience
Easy to install: just simply connect the plugs of the trailer towing mirror to the corresponding power cord, no drilling or modifications required（professional installation would be highly recommended）
Note: please check if your vehicle has the same functions as that of towing mirrors, such as turn signal, otherwise some functions of towing mirrors will be disabled when the vehicle does not possess the corresponding functions

specifications.Material: Textured abs plastic; Metal aluminum base
